note: Weekly per-game PPR projections: season ppg x opponent def-vs-pos multiplier (PPR allowed/gm vs league avg — def-vs-pos blends 2026 weeks 1-2 at 25% over 2025 — deviation shrunk to 40% of observed, clamped [0.82,1.18]) x home/away (1.02/0.98), normalized to mean 1.0 per team so weeks sum to the season line. null = bye. Points assume the player plays; gp carries the season games discount. Half/Std: pts - 0.5*rec or pts - rec, where weekly rec scales with the same multiplier (rec_w = recPG * pts_w / ppg). gsis/sleeper ids stamped from the player crosswalk (null when the player has no NFL gsis yet). K/DST (one per team): season line = league avg + shrunk team deviation (0.5/0.4); K rows use the current depth-chart PK1 (own prior PPG blended 50/50 when >=8 games); K scoring FG 3/4/5 by distance + XP; DST scoring sack 1 / INT 2 / fum rec 2 / TD 6 / safety 2 + standard points-allowed brackets; defVsPos[T].K = K pts defense T allows, defVsPos[T].DST = DST pts offense T concedes. Sleeper DST id = team code. IDP (DL/LB/DB, top 96 per bucket by default-catalog points): the season component build split across the schedule, scored tackle 1 / sack 2 / INT 3 / fum rec 2 / TD 6 / safety 2 — re-price from the components on the season board. The IDP matchup swing is small by construction: how much an offense concedes to a bucket barely repeats year over year (r = +0.25 DL, +0.24 LB, +0.08 DB), so the deviation is kept at 24%/24%/8% of observed and sharpens as in-season weeks blend in.
actualsNote: act / actRec = actual PPR points and receptions per REG week from the nflverse game logs, for weeks already played (<= playedThrough); null where the player did not play. Re-score with the same reception arithmetic as the projections: half = act - 0.5*actRec, std = act - actRec, TE premium = act + bonus*actRec.
injuryNote: inj = the newest weekly injury report (nflverse): status Out / Doubtful / Questionable and the report week. The strip is NOT discounted here. Apply it as a multiplier (Out → 0, Doubtful ×0.25, Questionable flagged) only when the week you are projecting IS the report week; for a later week show it as an unconfirmed flag — reports post Wed-Sat, and last week's Out is not this week's.
statusNote: status = nflverse roster status at build time (ACT active, RES reserve/IR/PUP, EXE commissioner exempt, DEV practice squad, INA game-day inactive, FA not on any roster; null when no roster file). active=false rows (RES/EXE/DEV/FA) have every week from currentWeek on zeroed — they are kept so a consumer can see who is out and restore the strip the day the roster flips back to ACT; wkIfActive on those rows is the un-zeroed conditional strip, for consumers that redistribute the vacated production. RET/CUT rows are dropped. backup=true marks a 1-3 game line for a depth-2+ player: a per-game rate conditional on playing, to be ranked below starters. playedThrough counts a week only once every scheduled game in it is final; currentWeek = playedThrough + 1.
marketNote: Weeks with a published market line use the implied team total as the scoring-environment term, blended 60% against def-vs-pos team strength, with the home/away nudge dropped (the line prices home field) and the position-specific deviation from def-vs-pos still applied on top. Over 3,726 team-games (2019-2025) an implied total predicts actual points at RMSE 9.13 against 10.16 for prior-season points per game and 10.20 for the current season to date — it subsumes what we knew. The weight is below 1 on purpose: that measurement used CLOSING lines, while what is published in advance is a lookahead price. Caveat: the market term is normalized over a team's LINED games and the fallback over all of them, so the split between lined and unlined weeks is approximate; the season total is unaffected, since all 17 weeks are renormalized to mean 1.
rosNote: rosPts / rosGames / rosPPG / gamesRemaining cover weeks after 2 (0 = preseason, so they equal the full season). rosPts already carries the availability discount (gp/17); rosPPG does not — it is the per-game rate over the remaining slate, which differs from the season ppg when the rest of the schedule is easier or harder than the part already played.
